We understand you discovered us through an AI recommendation; however, such sources may not always reflect our menu or ingredients accurately. For anything health-related, we always recommend checking directly with us.

That said, we would really appreciate the opportunity to speak with you, understand this in more detail, and make things right. Please feel free to reach out to us directly at 8291599737.

featured_reviews.review_text:
Jai Jawan Stall Gola Kulfi Falooda Centre, located next to Birla Kreda Kendra, Bhel Plaza, Chowpatty, Girgaon, Mumbai, Maharashtra, is a dessert spot that has become an iconic destination for locals and tourists alike. Nestled in one of Mumbai’s most vibrant and historic areas, this stall offers not just delicious treats but also a nostalgic experience of Mumbai’s street food culture.

The strategic location near Chowpatty, a famous beach in Mumbai, adds to the appeal of this stall. It’s the perfect place to stop by after a stroll along the beach or a visit to nearby attractions. The proximity to Birla Kreda Kendra also makes it a convenient spot for families and individuals looking to enjoy a quick, refreshing dessert after engaging in sports or other activities.

The Gola, a signature treat at this stall, is a must-try. Made from finely crushed ice and flavored with an assortment of syrups, it’s a quintessential Mumbai treat that brings back memories of childhood for many. The Kala Khatta Gola, in particular, is a crowd favorite, offering a tangy, sweet, and slightly spicy experience in every bite.

Their Kulfi, served on a stick, is another highlight. Available in traditional flavors like malai, pista, and kesar, the Kulfi here is known for its creamy texture and authentic taste. It’s a simple yet indulgent dessert that perfectly complements the vibrant atmosphere of Girgaon.

The Falooda, a layered dessert featuring vermicelli, basil seeds, rose syrup, and Kulfi, is also a popular choice. It’s both refreshing and filling, making it a great option for those looking to satisfy their sweet tooth.

Given its prime location and the quality of its offerings, Jai Jawan Stall is often crowded, especially in the evenings and on weekends. However, the quick and efficient service ensures that customers don’t have to wait too long to enjoy their favorite treats.

In conclusion, the Jai Jawan Stall Gola Kulfi Falooda Centre is not just a place to satisfy your dessert cravings, but also a significant part of Mumbai’s cultural and culinary landscape. Its convenient location near Chowpatty and Birla Kreda Kendra adds to its charm, making it a must-visit spot for anyone exploring this part of the city.

Apsara icecream is a renowned icecream parlour  brand of Mumbai since around 50 yrs. I believe as of today they have about 30 outlets in Mumbai itself.They also have outlets spread across other cities of India.I visited their Malabar hill outlet  yesterday night which is their iconic outlet

They serve variety of icecreams in cups(small,medium.large)  as well as cones.

Icecreams made here are with natural flavours and not artificial flavours.These icecreams are handchurned icecreams.

Staff service is reasonably good at Malabar hill outlet but i personally have seen better staff service at other parlours.Definite scope of improvement on staff service front.Apart from icecreams they also have sorbets & shakes.

Coming to variety of icecreams i tried here

Guava glory (small cup)- Star icecream of Apsara for me .Try it with red chilli powder(peru chaat masala) on top of icecream .Highly recommended

Malai kulfi stick -This about taking you back to sweet childhood memories.

Its a delicious sweet dessert served on stick .You will relish it if you like malai flavour.They also have options in pistachio and kesar pista.

Beligan bites (cone) -This i tried in waffle cone.This is all about enjoying Beligan chocolate with chips

Scrumptious sitafal(small cup) -A perfect combination of icecream and exotic creamy fruit.This is dessert goodness at next level.I personally loved it

Pan pasand(cone) - Before visiting this place.I had heard a lot of good things about their pan pasand icecream.Try this and you will thank me for recommending it

Tamarind twist(sorbet) - Imli in form of dessert.This is innovation and experimentation at its best.This sorbet has sharp flavour of tangy tamarind.

My overall experience was reasonably good at Apsara icecreams.A good option for late night icecream cravings.

I genuinely hope to see them coming up with premium range of desserts in coming times.

I didnt try their Thandai and couple of other shakes.Will definitely try it the next time i visit them

Overall - Definitely worth your  money

Check it out

Saumil shah

If you’re someone who truly appreciates real ice cream, Bina’s Ice Cream is an absolute delight!
What sets them apart is their commitment to purity — every scoop is made purely from milk, with no added preservatives, chemicals, or artificial powders. You can genuinely taste the difference. My personal favorite has to be the Guava Chilli ice cream — a perfect balance of sweet, tangy, and a subtle kick that keeps you wanting more. The Lotus Biscoff is another standout, offering that comforting caramelized richness. Their Chocolate flavor is classic yet deeply satisfying, and the Sugarcane Gourmet is refreshingly different — something you don’t come across every day!
